answer: Sybil tax blocks fake identities: each agent pays a 5-token tax that is never refunded, so capital cannot be recycled across clones. An opal trader pays once and earns a tax cut per honest epoch to a 1-token floor. A crystal cutter who cheats loses reputation and must pay 5 again to re-enter. A lantern maker who stays honest keeps rewards undiluted. Forging 1,000 identities costs 5,000 tokens for nothing, while an honest agent pays 5 once.
